doc.title: Genevieve Rose interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, March 14, 1998

chapter: Bass history, future and the scene
title: Meeting veteran and women bassists
summary: She has met Rufus Reid and Ray Brown, not Milt Hinton, and knows few women bassists personally.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Bass players: lineage, tone and technique

blocks.x: Who of the real veteran bassists around these days have you been able to meet? I’m interested if you’ve met Milt Hinton yet?

No I haven’t. I met Rufus Reid for like a minute a couple of years ago at a Massachusetts Music Educators’ Convention. But no I haven’t been able — I met Ray Brown this past summer at that Henry Mancini Institute. But I look forward to meeting them.
Are there any other women bass players on the scene? I mean I know there’s some, but are you familiar with any of them, or does it not make that much difference?
I don’t know any personally really. I know of some but I don’t know them. But that’s not something I really pay attention to.
You just do your own thing.
